name: circulation-api

dependencies.name: catalogue-service
dependencies.description: Searches titles, manages titles and copies, finds available copies and updates copy status on checkout, return and hold.

description: The only API the web app calls. Owns loans (14-day due date), holds queues, and late fees (0.25 per day overdue, computed at return), persisted in its own Postgres, and enforces borrowing rules (5-loan limit, no borrowing with unpaid fees, one hold per title). Proxies catalogue reads and librarian catalogue management to the catalogue service. Serves member /me/ operations and librarian operations behind the gateway. It does not store titles or copies and runs no background jobs.
